# WARNING: RISK OF THYROID C-CELL TUMORS
In rats, tirzepatide causes thyroid C-cell tumors. ZEPBOUND is contraindicated in patients with a personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).

## 2 Dosage and Administration
The recommended starting dosage is 2.5 mg injected subcutaneously once weekly. After 4 weeks increase to 5 mg once weekly. The recommended maintenance dosages are 5 mg, 10 mg, or 15 mg once weekly.

## 7 Drug Interactions
ZEPBOUND may reduce the efficacy of oral hormonal contraceptives. Advise patients using oral hormonal contraceptives to switch to a non-oral contraceptive method, or add a barrier method of contraception for 4 weeks after initiation and for 4 weeks after each dose escalation.
